caseNameFull: C. B. Boyett, in Error v. United States
summary: In error to the District Court of the United States for the Eastern District of Arkansas.
attorneys: Mr. J. W. Blackwood for plaintiffs in error. The Attorney General for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment reversed and cause remanded with a direction to sustain the motion in arrest of judgment, on- the authority of Hodges v. United States, 203 U. S. 1.
